name: Tornabous (Spain)
description: Light green field charged at the centre with a white bull passant towards the hoist, with a white ploughshare at the upper hoist.
history: The official flag of Tornabous is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, light green, with the white bull passant towards the hoist of the arms, 3/5 of the height and 7/15 of the length of the cloth, at the centre, and the white ploughshare of the arms; approved by the Generalitat on 6 July 2016 and published in the DOGC on 18 July 2016.
